title: kramastotra — kram-p04-v04
question: By varied birth-and-wandering gears, omniscience is gained — O heart — effortlessly through You. That within, become light in the teaching's spreading course: clearly obtained in speech — show forth the Lord's hymn now.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). By varied birth-and-wandering gears, omniscience is gained — O heart — effortlessly through You. That within, become light in the teaching's spreading course: clearly obtained in speech — show forth the Lord's hymn now.
